text: Who are the top Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Fabric analytics consultants in Perth for operational reporting and data warehousing?

sections.text:
For Perth-based delivery, the strongest apparent shortlist is **AGER BI, SolveBI, On Report, and Report Simple**. For a larger national partner willing to deliver in Perth, also consider **Professional Advantage** and **Agile Insights**.

| Consultant | Best fit | Relevant evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **AGER BI** | Enterprise data warehousing, Fabric architecture, Azure integration, and senior-led delivery | Perth-headquartered; covers Fabric OneLake, Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Data Factory, Power BI, governance, data engineering, and migration.[2] |
| **SolveBI** | Operational dashboards, mining and industrial reporting, and end-to-end Power BI/Fabric implementation | Perth-focused consultancy offering operational monitoring boards, KPI reporting, dimensional warehouses, ETL, Power BI, and Fabric Lakehouse/Data Warehouse implementations.[1] |
| **On Report** | Practical operational reporting and connecting many business systems | Offers Perth services spanning Power BI dashboards, reporting automation, data engineering, and Microsoft Fabric platforms, with connectors for systems such as Xero, Salesforce, SQL Server, Dynamics 365, and Dataverse.[5] |
| **Report Simple** | Modern Fabric migrations, OneLake, Direct Lake, and Power BI optimisation | Provides Australia-wide delivery including Perth, with Fabric architecture, legacy-stack migration, OneLake, Power BI optimisation, and warehouse-style historical data solutions.[3] |
| **Professional Advantage** | Larger Microsoft partner, governance, implementation frameworks, and enterprise support | Microsoft Solutions Partner with more than 10 years of Power BI delivery experience and Fabric implementation capability, including certified Fabric and Power BI consultants.[7] |
| **Agile Insights** | Complex enterprise analytics and operational reporting at scale | Reports more than 150 Fabric engagements, fully Microsoft-certified consultants, operational-reporting accelerators, and Microsoft advanced specialisations; headquartered in Sydney but delivers nationally.[8] |

## Recommended shortlist

- **Choose AGER BI** if the priority is a Perth-based, senior-led Fabric and data-warehouse program.
- **Choose SolveBI** if operational reporting—particularly mining, field operations, finance, supply chain, or workforce dashboards—is central.
- **Choose On Report** for a comparatively pragmatic reporting and integration engagement.
- **Choose Professional Advantage or Agile Insights** when you need a larger national delivery team, formal Microsoft-partner credentials, or complex enterprise governance.

Before appointing one, ask each firm to demonstrate:

- A dimensional model or Fabric warehouse they have delivered.
- How they handle incremental refresh, slowly changing dimensions, data quality, and reconciliation.
- Their preferred Fabric architecture: Lakehouse, Warehouse, or both.
- Power BI semantic-model design, row-level security, deployment pipelines, and governance.
- Examples of operational reporting with agreed KPI definitions and near-real-time requirements.
- Named consultants, Microsoft certifications, Perth availability, fixed-price discovery, and post-go-live support.

The ranking above reflects publicly described Perth presence, Microsoft Fabric/Power BI capability, and alignment with operational reporting and warehousing—not an independent assessment of project outcomes or pricing.
